task.title: Navigate the six Guided editor steps
task.shortdesc: Move through Profile & baseline, Browser access & defaults, Security & privacy, Users, add-ons & sites, AI & smart features, and Review & export.

prereq.p: Open a profile in Guided editor from the Library or creation flow.

context.p: Guided editor turns profile configuration into six task-first steps and keeps schema validation visible while you work.

image.alt: Guided editor showing the step navigation and validation state for a saved profile.

step.cmd: Start with Step 1, Profile & baseline, to confirm name, schema channel, scenario, starter preset, and CIS layer.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Continue through Step 2, Browser access & defaults, for network access, browser behavior, home, search, and navigation defaults.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Use Step 3 for privacy controls, permissions, cookies, cleanup, DNS, and security hardening posture.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Use Step 4 for accounts, extensions, bookmarks, language, translation, add-ons, and website handling.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Use Step 5 only for existing Firefox AI & smart features policy controls that the selected schema supports.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Finish in Step 6, Review & export, to validate, save, and download the reviewed profile.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: You can explain where each guided setting belongs and continue from the correct step.

postreq.p: Recovery: if you land in the wrong area, use the stepper or search instead of changing unrelated controls. For a saved profile, open schema conversion review only after you decide to change channel: preserve unsaved work first, choose a distinct supported target, and use the read-only preview before any explicit apply.
